The journalist traveled to multiple countries to gather firsthand accounts and document the impact of the global policy shift.

**Semantic Role Labeling:**

*   **The journalist**: Agent (the entity performing the action)
*   **traveled**: Verb (the main action)
*   **to multiple countries**: Location/Destination (where the action took place)
*   **to gather firsthand accounts**: Purpose/Goal (why the action was performed)
*   **to document the impact of the global policy shift**: Purpose/Goal (why the action was performed)
